text: ふなよい　しない　ふなのり　にゅうもん…　…これは　せんちょうが　よんでいる　ほんだ！

structure.jp: ふなよい　しない　ふなのり　にゅうもん…
structure.en: "Primer for the Sailor Who Doesn't Get Seasick"...

structure.jp: せんちょうが　よんでいる　ほんだ！
structure.en: the book the captain is reading!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ふなよい　しない　ふなのり
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase put right before a thing or person describes it, like English 'who' or 'that'. The same happens later in せんちょうが　よんでいる　ほん, 'the book the captain is reading'. ふなよい　しない　ふなのり = 'a sailor who doesn't get seasick'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now. よんでいる = 'is reading'.
